#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Works entirely in memory on the OOXML package (zip): creates ppt/slides/slideN.xml,
its rels, and updates [Content_Types].xml, ppt/presentation.xml,
ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels, and docProps/app.xml. Stdlib only.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

P_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
SLIDE_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
LAYOUT_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"

TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"


def find_input():
    if os.path.exists("Q4_financial_report.pptx"):
        return "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".codex", ".git")]
        for f in files:
            if f == "Q4_financial_report.pptx":
                return os.path.join(root, f)
    sys.exit("Q4_financial_report.pptx not found")


def max_slide_num(entries):
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for n in entries
            if (m := re.match(r"^ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))]
    return max(nums) if nums else 0


def slide_dimensions(pres_xml):
    try:
        sz = ET.fromstring(pres_xml).find(".//{%s}sldSz" % P_NS)
        if sz is not None:
            return int(sz.get("cx")), int(sz.get("cy"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 12192000, 6858000


def last_slide_layout(entries, last_num):
    rels_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % last_num
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(entries[rels_name])
    except Exception:
        return None
    for rel in root:
        if rel.get("Type", "").endswith("/slideLayout"):
            return rel.get("Target")
    return None


def next_rid(rels_xml):
    ids = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels_xml)]
    return "rId%d" % ((max(ids) + 1) if ids else 1)


def next_slide_id(pres_xml):
    ids = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*id="(\d+)"', pres_xml)]
    return (max(ids) + 1) if ids else 256


def make_slide_xml(cx, cy):
    left, width = int(cx * 0.08), int(cx * 0.84)
    top, height = int(cy * 0.40), int(cy * 0.22)
    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" '
        'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
        'xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">\n'
        '  <p:cSld>\n'
        '    <p:spTree>\n'
        '      <p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>\n'
        '        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>\n'
        '        <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '      </p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '        <a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '        </a:xfrm>\n'
        '      </p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:sp>\n'
        '        <p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/>\n'
        '          <p:cNvSpPr><a:spLocks noGrp="1"/></p:cNvSpPr>\n'
        '          <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '        </p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:spPr>\n'
        '          <a:xfrm>\n'
        '            <a:off x="%d" y="%d"/>\n'
        '            <a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/>\n'
        '          </a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>\n'
        '          <a:noFill/>\n'
        '        </p:spPr>\n'
        '        <p:txBody>\n'
        '          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr"><a:spAutoFit/></a:bodyPr>\n'
        '          <a:lstStyle/>\n'
        '          <a:p>\n'
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        '            <a:r>\n'
        '              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1" dirty="0"/>\n'
        '              <a:t>%s</a:t>\n'
        '            </a:r>\n'
        '          </a:p>\n'
        '        </p:txBody>\n'
        '      </p:sp>\n'
        '    </p:spTree>\n'
        '  </p:cSld>\n'
        '  <p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '    <a:overrideClrMapping bg1="lt1" tx1="dk1" bg2="lt2" tx2="dk2" '
        'accent1="accent1" accent2="accent2" accent3="accent3" accent4="accent4" '
        'accent5="accent5" accent6="accent6" hlink="hlink" folHlink="folHlink"/>\n'
        '  </p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '</p:sld>\n'
    ) % (left, top, width, height, TEXT)


def make_slide_rels_xml(target):
    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">\n'
        '  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>\n'
        '</Relationships>\n' % (LAYOUT_REL_TYPE, target)
    )


def main():
    src = find_input()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src, "r") as z:
        bad = z.testzip()
        if bad:
            sys.exit("corrupt source zip member: %s" % bad)
        entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

    if "ppt/presentation.xml" not in entries:
        sys.exit("not a valid pptx: missing ppt/presentation.xml")

    last = max_slide_num(entries)
    new_num = last + 1
    slide_path = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num
    rels_path = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num

    pres_xml = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    cx, cy = slide_dimensions(entries["ppt/presentation.xml"])

    # Pick the layout used by the previous slide so the design matches.
    target = last_slide_layout(entries, last) if last else None
    layouts = sorted(n for n in entries
                     if re.match(r"^ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml$", n))
    if not target or not target.startswith("../slideLayouts/"):
        target = "../slideLayouts/%s" % os.path.basename(layouts[0]) if layouts else None
    if target is None:
        sys.exit("no slide layout found in package")
    if not target.startswith("../slideLayouts/"):
        target = "../slideLayouts/%s" % os.path.basename(target)
    if os.path.join("ppt", target[3:]) not in entries:
        target = "../slideLayouts/%s" % os.path.basename(layouts[0])

    # [Content_Types].xml
    ct_name = "[Content_Types].xml"
    ct_xml = entries[ct_name].decode("utf-8")
    override = '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>' % (slide_path, SLIDE_CT)
    if "/%s" % slide_path not in ct_xml:
        if "</Types>" not in ct_xml:
            sys.exit("unexpected [Content_Types].xml layout")
        ct_xml = ct_xml.replace("</Types>", "  " + override + "\n</Types>")

    # ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels
    rels_name = "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
    rels_xml = entries[rels_name].decode("utf-8")
    rid = next_rid(rels_xml)
    new_rel = '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>' % (rid, SLIDE_REL_TYPE, slide_path)
    if "</Relationships>" not in rels_xml:
        sys.exit("unexpected presentation.xml.rels layout")
    rels_xml = rels_xml.replace("</Relationships>", "  " + new_rel + "\n</Relationships>")

    # ppt/presentation.xml -> append slide id
    sid = next_slide_id(pres_xml)
    sldid = '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="%s"/>' % (sid, rid)
    if "</p:sldIdLst>" in pres_xml:
        pres_xml = pres_xml.replace("</p:sldIdLst>", "  " + sldid + "\n</p:sldIdLst>")
    elif "<p:sldIdLst/>" in pres_xml:
        pres_xml = pres_xml.replace("<p:sldIdLst/>", "<p:sldIdLst>\n  " + sldid + "\n</p:sldIdLst>")
    else:
        sys.exit("cannot locate sldIdLst in presentation.xml")

    # docProps/app.xml slide count
    app_name = "docProps/app.xml"
    app_xml = None
    if app_name in entries:
        app_xml = entries[app_name].decode("utf-8")
        m = re.search(r"<Slides>(\d+)</Slides>", app_xml)
        if m:
            app_xml = app_xml.replace(m.group(0), "<Slides>%d</Slides>" % (int(m.group(1)) + 1), 1)

    slide_xml = make_slide_xml(cx, cy)
    slide_rels_xml = make_slide_rels_xml(target)

    new_entries = []
    names = [n for n in entries if n != ct_name]
    new_entries.append((ct_name, ct_xml.encode("utf-8")))
    for n in names:
        if n == rels_name:
            new_entries.append((n, rels_xml.encode("utf-8")))
        elif n == "ppt/presentation.xml":
            new_entries.append((n, pres_xml.encode("utf-8")))
        elif n == app_name and app_xml is not None:
            new_entries.append((n, app_xml.encode("utf-8")))
        else:
            new_entries.append((n, entries[n]))
    new_entries.append((slide_path, slide_xml.encode("utf-8")))
    new_entries.append((rels_path, slide_rels_xml.encode("utf-8")))

    tmp = src + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for name, data in new_entries:
            z.writestr(name, data)

    shutil.copy2(src, src + ".bak")
    os.replace(tmp, src)

    # Post-write validation: zip integrity + well-formed XML across the package.
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src, "r") as z:
        if z.testzip():
            sys.exit("verification failed: corrupt output zip")
        out_names = z.namelist()
        out_pres = z.read("ppt/presentation.xml").decode("utf-8")
        if slide_path not in out_names or rels_path not in out_names:
            sys.exit("verification failed: new slide parts missing")
        for n in out_names:
            if n.endswith((".xml", ".rels")) and not n.startswith("docProps/"):
                ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
    count = len(re.findall(r"<p:sldId ", out_pres))
    print("OK: added %s (slide id %d, rel %s, layout %s); presentation now has %d slides"
          % (slide_path, sid, rid, target, count))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Works entirely in memory on the OOXML package (zip): creates ppt/slides/slideN.xml,
its rels, and updates [Content_Types].xml, ppt/presentation.xml,
ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels, and docProps/app.xml. Stdlib only.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

P_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
SLIDE_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
LAYOUT_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"

TEXT = "Thank you for your attention"


def find_input():
    if os.path.exists("Q4_financial_report.pptx"):
        return "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".codex", ".git")]
        for f in files:
            if f == "Q4_financial_report.pptx":
                return os.path.join(root, f)
    sys.exit("Q4_financial_report.pptx not found")


def max_slide_num(entries):
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for n in entries
            if (m := re.match(r"^ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", n))]
    return max(nums) if nums else 0


def slide_dimensions(pres_xml):
    try:
        sz = ET.fromstring(pres_xml).find(".//{%s}sldSz" % P_NS)
        if sz is not None:
            return int(sz.get("cx")), int(sz.get("cy"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 12192000, 6858000


def last_slide_layout(entries, last_num):
    rels_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % last_num
    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(entries[rels_name])
    except Exception:
        return None
    for rel in root:
        if rel.get("Type", "").endswith("/slideLayout"):
            return rel.get("Target")
    return None


def next_rid(rels_xml):
    ids = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels_xml)]
    return "rId%d" % ((max(ids) + 1) if ids else 1)


def next_slide_id(pres_xml):
    ids = [int(m) for m in re.findall(r'<p:sldId[^>]*id="(\d+)"', pres_xml)]
    return (max(ids) + 1) if ids else 256


def make_slide_xml(cx, cy):
    left, width = int(cx * 0.08), int(cx * 0.84)
    top, height = int(cy * 0.40), int(cy * 0.22)
    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" '
        'xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" '
        'xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">\n'
        '  <p:cSld>\n'
        '    <p:spTree>\n'
        '      <p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>\n'
        '        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>\n'
        '        <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '      </p:nvGrpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '        <a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>\n'
        '          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>\n'
        '        </a:xfrm>\n'
        '      </p:grpSpPr>\n'
        '      <p:sp>\n'
        '        <p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYouText"/>\n'
        '          <p:cNvSpPr><a:spLocks noGrp="1"/></p:cNvSpPr>\n'
        '          <p:nvPr/>\n'
        '        </p:nvSpPr>\n'
        '        <p:spPr>\n'
        '          <a:xfrm>\n'
        '            <a:off x="%d" y="%d"/>\n'
        '            <a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/>\n'
        '          </a:xfrm>\n'
        '          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>\n'
        '          <a:noFill/>\n'
        '        </p:spPr>\n'
        '        <p:txBody>\n'
        '          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr"><a:spAutoFit/></a:bodyPr>\n'
        '          <a:lstStyle/>\n'
        '          <a:p>\n'
        '            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>\n'
        '            <a:r>\n'
        '              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1" dirty="0"/>\n'
        '              <a:t>%s</a:t>\n'
        '            </a:r>\n'
        '          </a:p>\n'
        '        </p:txBody>\n'
        '      </p:sp>\n'
        '    </p:spTree>\n'
        '  </p:cSld>\n'
        '  <p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '    <a:overrideClrMapping bg1="lt1" tx1="dk1" bg2="lt2" tx2="dk2" '
        'accent1="accent1" accent2="accent2" accent3="accent3" accent4="accent4" '
        'accent5="accent5" accent6="accent6" hlink="hlink" folHlink="folHlink"/>\n'
        '  </p:clrMapOvr>\n'
        '</p:sld>\n'
    ) % (left, top, width, height, TEXT)


def make_slide_rels_xml(target):
    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">\n'
        '  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>\n'
        '</Relationships>\n' % (LAYOUT_REL_TYPE, target)
    )


def main():
    src = find_input()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src, "r") as z:
        bad = z.testzip()
        if bad:
            sys.exit("corrupt source zip member: %s" % bad)
        entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

    if "ppt/presentation.xml" not in entries:
        sys.exit("not a valid pptx: missing ppt/presentation.xml")

    last = max_slide_num(entries)
    new_num = last + 1
    slide_path = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num
    rels_path = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num

    pres_xml = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    cx, cy = slide_dimensions(entries["ppt/presentation.xml"])

    # Pick the layout used by the previous slide so the design matches.
    target = last_slide_layout(entries, last) if last else None
    layouts = sorted(n for n in entries
                     if re.match(r"^ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout\d+\.xml$", n))
    if not target or not target.startswith("../slideLayouts/"):
        target = "../slideLayouts/%s" % os.path.basename(layouts[0]) if layouts else None
    if target is None:
        sys.exit("no slide layout found in package")
    if not target.startswith("../slideLayouts/"):
        target = "../slideLayouts/%s" % os.path.basename(target)
    if os.path.join("ppt", target[3:]) not in entries:
        target = "../slideLayouts/%s" % os.path.basename(layouts[0])

    # [Content_Types].xml
    ct_name = "[Content_Types].xml"
    ct_xml = entries[ct_name].decode("utf-8")
    override = '<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>' % (slide_path, SLIDE_CT)
    if "/%s" % slide_path not in ct_xml:
        if "</Types>" not in ct_xml:
            sys.exit("unexpected [Content_Types].xml layout")
        ct_xml = ct_xml.replace("</Types>", "  " + override + "\n</Types>")

    # ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels
    rels_name = "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
    rels_xml = entries[rels_name].decode("utf-8")
    rid = next_rid(rels_xml)
    new_rel = '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>' % (rid, SLIDE_REL_TYPE, slide_path)
    if "</Relationships>" not in rels_xml:
        sys.exit("unexpected presentation.xml.rels layout")
    rels_xml = rels_xml.replace("</Relationships>", "  " + new_rel + "\n</Relationships>")

    # ppt/presentation.xml -> append slide id
    sid = next_slide_id(pres_xml)
    sldid = '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="%s"/>' % (sid, rid)
    if "</p:sldIdLst>" in pres_xml:
        pres_xml = pres_xml.replace("</p:sldIdLst>", "  " + sldid + "\n</p:sldIdLst>")
    elif "<p:sldIdLst/>" in pres_xml:
        pres_xml = pres_xml.replace("<p:sldIdLst/>", "<p:sldIdLst>\n  " + sldid + "\n</p:sldIdLst>")
    else:
        sys.exit("cannot locate sldIdLst in presentation.xml")

    # docProps/app.xml slide count
    app_name = "docProps/app.xml"
    app_xml = None
    if app_name in entries:
        app_xml = entries[app_name].decode("utf-8")
        m = re.search(r"<Slides>(\d+)</Slides>", app_xml)
        if m:
            app_xml = app_xml.replace(m.group(0), "<Slides>%d</Slides>" % (int(m.group(1)) + 1), 1)

    slide_xml = make_slide_xml(cx, cy)
    slide_rels_xml = make_slide_rels_xml(target)

    new_entries = []
    names = [n for n in entries if n != ct_name]
    new_entries.append((ct_name, ct_xml.encode("utf-8")))
    for n in names:
        if n == rels_name:
            new_entries.append((n, rels_xml.encode("utf-8")))
        elif n == "ppt/presentation.xml":
            new_entries.append((n, pres_xml.encode("utf-8")))
        elif n == app_name and app_xml is not None:
            new_entries.append((n, app_xml.encode("utf-8")))
        else:
            new_entries.append((n, entries[n]))
    new_entries.append((slide_path, slide_xml.encode("utf-8")))
    new_entries.append((rels_path, slide_rels_xml.encode("utf-8")))

    tmp = src + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for name, data in new_entries:
            z.writestr(name, data)

        if z.testzip():
            sys.exit("verification failed: corrupt output zip")
        out_names = z.namelist()
        out_pres = z.read("ppt/presentation.xml").decode("utf-8")
        if slide_path not in out_names or rels_path not in out_names:
            sys.exit("verification failed: new slide parts missing")
        for n in out_names:
            if n.endswith((".xml", ".rels")) and not n.startswith("docProps/"):
                ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
    count = len(re.findall(r"<p:sldId ", out_pres))
    print("OK: added %s (slide id %d, rel %s, layout %s); presentation now has %d slides"
          % (slide_path, sid, rid, target, count))

    main()
